signature.name: VTask.gnpowRec
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {A : ι → Type u_2} -> [AddMonoid ι] -> [GradedMonoid.GMul A] -> [GradedMonoid.GOne A] -> (n : ℕ) -> {i : ι} -> A i → A (n • i)

conventions.statement: When n = 0, the input element a is ignored and the result is the graded unit element (of grade 0), cast to grade 0 • i via the identity zero_nsmul.
conventions.note: Mirrors npowRec base case: 0th power is always the unit.

conventions.statement: When n = k + 1, the result is the graded product of gnpowRec k a and a, cast to grade (k+1) • i via succ_nsmul.
conventions.note: Defines powering by left-multiplication: a^(k+1) = a^k * a in the graded sense.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {A : ι → Type*} [AddMonoid ι] [GradedMonoid.GMul A] [GradedMonoid.GOne A] {i : ι} (a : A i), GradedMonoid.mk _ (VTask.gnpowRec 0 a) = 1

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {A : ι → Type*} [AddMonoid ι] [GradedMonoid.GMul A] [GradedMonoid.GOne A] (n : ℕ) {i : ι} (a : A i), GradedMonoid.mk _ (VTask.gnpowRec n.succ a) = ⟨_, VTask.gnpowRec n a⟩ * ⟨_, a⟩

facts.violated_property: At n = 1, gnpowRec is NOT generally the graded unit; that only holds at n = 0
